items.check: The finish scene: the round GLB tree with the textured fox beside it, both fully visible, no selection gizmo.
items.notes: Pixel Preview must be OFF for this shot (it hides the editor grid and the editor preview sun); the recipe toggles it first. F on the fox, three wheel steps out, then a level orbit (middle-drag up ~140 px), a small wheel-in and a slight azimuth turn reproduce the low horizon of the media; the final click on empty ground clears the selection box.

The window is closed with Esc (changes not applied).

items.check: The tree instance doubles in size after Root Scale 1.0 to 2.0 and Reimport.
items.notes: The Import dock is activated first, then drag-model.py --click selects round_tree.glb from the courtyard folder in the split FileSystem list (row 3 after '..': fountain, pillar, round_tree, stone_ring). The active imported_models scene stays as it is, so changing Root Scale to 2.0 and clicking Reimport doubles the instance live (the media's effect). set-import-float.py finds the EditorPropertyFloat rows in the dock at run time.

items.check: The StandardMaterial3D inspector for the leaf mesh with the material expanded inline, then the orange Albedo colour set through the colour picker's hex field.
items.notes: make-material.py finds the Surface Material Override picker at run time, opens its popup, clicks the StandardMaterial3D row from the popup's own item metrics and then clicks the picker's pencil to expand it inline (media 70). The inspector is at its top scroll position, so the Albedo section is the fourth indented material section; expand-albedo.py clicks it and the Color property, then set-color-hex.py types e07a2d into the untitled ColorPicker window. 71 frames the whole tree with 09-frame.py; 72 crops the slot + material from y=410.
